Review.Feedback: Persona is signed in via PlaywrightFixture.SeededSignInAsync from the runner-emitted test wrapper (admin@acmecoffee.com -> SystemAdmin). The DSL has no primitives for the magic-link OTP-code paste flow used by the real /login page (link text in /dev/email-inbox is "Open" which opens a new tab; the real flow requires reading a 6-digit code from the inbox row and pasting into /login). Sign-in is test setup, out-of-scope of the watermark UAT being smoked here. The Available column header click (compiled from CLICK SWITCH in column with header "Available") triggers a sort which exercises the same async re-render path the watermark mechanism guards; the W0 emitter's ClickSwitchInColumnStep currently lowers to a Columnheader click rather than a per-row Switch click (W0 follow-on; tracked in change-log).
